# Sell 50.00 USD against the credit an unpost handed back. That credit is a
# cost basis again and has no balance recorded, so how much of it is still
# unsold is not known and this must be refused.
#
# The USD bank is opened here because this book was built around a CAD one:
# the invoice was paid, and overpaid, from Assets:Bank in CAD.
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-03-05 * "Sell 50 USD of the credit"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -50.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.37"
		value: "-68.50"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{basis}"
	Assets:Bank 68.50 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "68.50"
